definition: Monthly labor force recode: 1-2 employed, 3-4 unemployed, 5-7 not in labor force
Major occupation group of current or last job; 1-2 = white-collar; 7-10 = blue-collar
Detailed occupation recode (e.g., 1 management, 2 business & financial, 3 computer & math, 8 education, 17 office & administrative support)
Major industry of current or last job (e.g., 7 information, 8 financial activities, 9 professional & business services, 10 education & health)
Highest education; 39 = high school diploma, 43+ = bachelor's or higher
Reason for unemployment; 1-3 = job losers (temporary layoff, other job loss, temporary job ended), 4 job leaver, 5 re-entrant, 6 new entrant
